claims.summary: Native Pass B uses model output capacity to batch long-output structured models into one normal full-course authoring call instead of fixed 4-lesson chunks.
Native recovery stops after a retry leaves the same missing lesson signature, avoiding repeated spend with no evidence of improvement.
The voice pass now batches the default selected eight-surface set into one fixed 4k-output provider call.
GPT-5.4/GPT-5.5 context metadata is updated and partial model lookup prefers the most specific matching model prefix.
